verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS customer data platform, but the evidence pack never documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. 'AI-powered audiences' on the pricing page is a feature-level marketing claim, not a delegable assistant. The 'Open in ChatGPT/Claude' links on docs pages hand content to external tools, so neither counts as support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
